mechanism.claim: At fixed twice-daily decisions, simultaneous causal one-hour realized-skew extremes across at least four alts reveal a directional higher-moment repricing wave. When those skew directions agree, BTC follows that skew-spillover direction for eight hours during locally elevated variation.
mechanism.side: strict sign of the absolute-realized-skew-weighted skew-sign consensus
mechanism.why_distinct: Cross-sectional return-tail asymmetry cubes six endpoint returns around their same-block median. HVCASK instead computes a normalized third moment through time inside each alt's twelve completed five-minute returns, ranks each alt against its own prior scheduled history, then requires broad agreement among extreme skew signs. It uses no cross-sectional endpoint centering, lag beta, current BTC direction, post-entry fit, reused event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: BTC completed 24-hour realized variation ranks in the upper 35 percent against the 20 strictly prior scheduled source-valid decisions, adapting causally to local July-like volatility
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: fixed 02:35 and 14:35 UTC entries with an eight-hour hold are absent from Gross9 primitive clocks

features.bars: exact five-minute OHLC aggregated from five consecutive bars_binance one-minute rows; all seven symbols complete, finite, positive, coherent; no imputation
features.decision_times: every calendar day at exact 02:30 and 14:30 UTC
features.alt_one_hour_realized_skew: sum(return cubed)/(sum(return squared)^(3/2)); 12 completed five-minute returns, denominator strict positive, result finite strict nonzero
features.skew_extreme_rank: for each alt independently, strict-prior midrank of absolute realized skew over at most 120 prior jointly valid scheduled decisions, minimum 60, current excluded; selected when rank>=0.65
features.score: sum(abs(realized_skew)*sign(realized_skew) over selected alts)/sum(abs(realized_skew) over selected alts)
features.consensus_gate: at least four selected alts, abs(score)>=0.50, and at least three selected skew signs equal score sign
features.btc_realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared exact BTC five-minute log(close/open) returns over [D-24h,D))
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over 20 prior jointly source-valid scheduled decisions, minimum 15, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.reservation: global chronological half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not signal input; exact settlements only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp/10bp per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source and novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent cross-alt time-series realized-skew spillover consensus mechanism

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no universe, aggregation, skew window, normalization, histories, ranks, consensus, local-volatility gate, direction, clock, hold, subset, comparator, or control repair
